question: Which away teams are tied for the most away wins in the Scottish Premier League 2009/2010 season?
gold_sql: WITH wins AS ( SELECT m.away_team_api_id, COUNT(*) AS n FROM Match AS m JOIN League AS l ON l.id = m.league_id WHERE l.name = 'Scotland Premier League' AND m.season = '2009/2010' AND m.away_team_goal > m.home_team_goal GROUP BY m.away_team_api_id ) SELECT t.team_long_name FROM wins AS w JOIN Team AS t ON t.team_api_id = w.away_team_api_id WHERE w.n = (SELECT MAX(n) FROM wins) ORDER BY t.team_api_id
